original_price.description: List price this line was discounted from (the product/variant selling_price at order time). Server-stamped by validateOrderPricing; equals `price` when the line is undiscounted.

discount_source.description: Why this line is below list. 'offer' → a live sale-offer (see sale_offer); 'product_offer_price' → the product's own offer_price; 'manual' → staff-entered price, requires discount_reason.

sale_offer.description: The live offer that justified this line's price. Set only when discount_source = 'offer'.

offer_name.description: Snapshot of the offer's name at order time — offers get renamed and deleted, the order line shouldn't lose its audit trail.

discount_reason.description: Staff justification for a manual discount. Required when discount_source = 'manual'.

sellable_qty.description: For a divisible product line: the number of sub-units sold on this line (e.g. yards/tablets). Whole-item lines leave this null and use quantity.

allocations.description: For a divisible line: the allocation breakdown [{stock_item, stock_item_id, units, unit_price, line_total, depleted}] produced by stock-item.allocateSellableUnits — the record a return releases.
